name: io.github.tonyyang0504/kakao_moment-mcp
description: 카카오모먼트 Kakao Moment (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, get_report, update_budget, pause_resum

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_KAKAO_MOMENT_BUSINESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Kakao business token (비즈니스 토큰) issued by POST https://kauth.kakao.com/oauth/business/token after the advertiser consents to moment_management in your biz app (https://developers.kakao.com/docs/latest/ko/business-auth/rest-api). No refresh flow; it expires after long non-use.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_KAKAO_MOMENT_AD_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Kakao Moment ad account number, sent as the `adAccountId` header that campaign and report calls require.
